description: A serialized property value declaring ValueSize = 8, below the 13-byte minimum
notes: Well-formed as a shell link, so the fixture expects "ok" at the gate. PropertyStorage::values yields the AppUserModelID and then ErrorKind::BadLength: a ValueSize below 13 cannot cover its own ValueSize, Id, Reserved and TypedPropertyValue header, and using it as the stride would leave the walk inside a field.
